top_choice_rationale: P003 pairs the one shortlisted achievement with a measurable, long-confirmed effect on how chemists build molecules (Buchwald and Hartwig, ligand-controlled Pd-catalysed C-N coupling, distinct from the 2010 C-C prize because reductive elimination from Pd-amido complexes and beta-hydride suppression are a separate mechanistic problem) with a chemically concrete second part, Liu alone for base editing via engineered deaminases, within three names. P004 is the cleaner single-achievement fallback if base editing is judged premature or its credit unresolved. The degrader proposals rank lower because no degrader is approved and the PROTAC and cereblon strands are in practice separate discoveries that a three-name cut cannot honestly cover.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; shared Lund affiliation with Linke and Sparr involves no credited name
